title: 13th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/13/1/2026).

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister of Infrastructure, Housing and Urban Development Dr Abdulla Muttalib: people are very worried by sudden reversals in flat-allocation decisions, with some recently told they would get a flat and then told further checks were needed and their agreement signing stopped; why were agreements signed without proper checks, and why is the full list of flat recipients not published instead of informing people one by one?

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to Minister Dr Abdulla Muttalib: President Dr Mohamed Muizzu and the government repeatedly called this year's budget a housing budget, yet nothing of the sort is visible; what housing projects have been run from the budget Parliament passed for this year, and what are the details of the spending?
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Constitution of the Republic of Maldives, submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Unfinished business: debate continues on the Bill to amend the Maldives Fisheries Act (Law No. 14/2019), submitted on behalf of the government by Thinadhoo South MP Mohamed Alsan Ahmed.

Unfinished business: debate continues on the resolution by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem on Public Service Media discriminating between political parties, denying the Maldivian Democratic Party the chance to inform the public, and failing to ensure the editorial independence required by law.

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's nominations of a non-resident ambassador to Cambodia and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and a non-resident ambassador to the Hellenic Republic (Greece).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting opened with two housing questions to the Housing Minister, began debate on a Constitution amendment bill, continued the Fisheries Act amendment and PSM resolution, and took up an ambassadors report.
